explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 86 named tracks/releases across Juno Recommends Techno's September 2026 chart, Boomkat's September 14 new/pre-order pages, adjacent 2026 label material and overlooked catalogue tracks. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. Explicit threat- or panic-coded propositions were deprioritized without creating a blanket intensity or genre ban.
Completed discovery Runs 236, 239, 240, 241 and 243 were compared before ranking. None of the top three proposed boundaries repeats a musically evaluated boundary from those runs.

Every ranked artist/title pair was checked against canonical state, target-local discovery/rejection/PARKED history and the global utility ledger. Recent exact, unresolved and evaluated identities were excluded; Picture — Quuuuuuu was specifically excluded because it remains an unresolved prior lead.

The nine ranked identities are new exact-title leads with individual track descriptions. Related Wavecycle leads are separately described; no artist, texture, novelty, genre, placement or role diversity quota is applied.
No proposed placement touches either protected internal handoff in Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.
